original_test_intent: Verify the complete CPU/DIMM power-sensor population against its approved CPU socket, memory channel, DIMM zone and power-rail specification across IB SDR/Sensor List, OOB SDR/Sensor List and BMC Web.
original_method: Bind every included power record to CPU, memory channel, DIMM zone and rail; retain complete aligned IB/OOB inventories and Web rows; separate power readings from temperature, voltage or other DIMM records; normalize units, scaling, state, thresholds, sample timing and load context without changing platform state.
manual_activity: The platform owner defines exact CPU_DIMM power membership, physical mappings, units and limits and resolves criteria 3–55; an operator records the Web rows and workload context, then the owner decides the verdict.
required_inputs: SUT/BMC/BIOS, CPU, memory and firmware identities
Exact CPU_DIMM power-sensor membership and CPU/socket/channel/DIMM-zone/rail mapping
Per-member units, scaling, instantaneous or averaged semantics, thresholds and expected load-dependent range
Rules separating power from temperature, voltage and other DIMM matches
Per-member IB/OOB/Web mapping and freshness tolerance
Aligned workload, CPU power-limit, memory population and thermal state
Secure access, complete Web capture and criteria 3–55 decision

Protect credentials and retain complete outputs
Do not treat every broad DIMM match as a power record
Do not use an item title as a sensor name or truncate evidence
Do not clear CPU, memory, power, thermal or SEL logs
Stop on identity ambiguity, missing/duplicate/stale value, power alarm, unit mismatch or channel disagreement

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: ipmitool is relevant, but `sensor get 'Power Reading - CPU_DIMM'` invents an aggregate record; the truncated fallback and absent Web evidence do not prove source scope.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Securely retain full IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists, classify every DIMM match, exact-match each approved CPU_DIMM power member, capture corresponding Web rows and compare with the approved physical and semantic map.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Both IB/OOB list checks, the broad DIMM source filter, BMC Web, SPEC comparison, Config-Check and 3/0-minute values remain; ambiguity is escalated rather than silently narrowed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a per-member matrix tied to CPU socket, memory channel, DIMM zone and rail under aligned workload and timestamps.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds explicit type filtering, physical identity and timing normalization without changing hardware state.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A broad DIMM grep can include unrelated sensor types, while a synthetic aggregate target can miss required rails or zones.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Power varies with memory population, workload, power policy and sampling cadence; approved ranges and alignment rules are required.

project_override_considerations: If an approved CPU_DIMM power member is absent from one surface, the owner must define equivalent evidence and preserve its coverage; unrelated DIMM sensors cannot substitute.

Versioned CPU_DIMM power specification and CPU/socket/channel/DIMM-zone/rail map
Complete redacted IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists with timestamps and exits

Complete BMC Web rows and per-member name/description/reading/unit/state/threshold/freshness comparison
Aligned memory population/workload/power-limit/thermal context, criteria 3–55 decision, no-write/no-clear audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source filters all DIMM records although the item is power-specific, provides no member or topology definition, and jumps from Criteria 2 to 56. DeepSeek instead invents one aggregate sensor and truncates the population.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Read-only inventory is feasible; the authoritative membership, mapping, limits and source clarification are supplyable inputs.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2030 Wistron-BMC-01049-V002: define the exact CPU_DIMM power-sensor population and CPU/socket/memory-channel/DIMM-zone/rail mapping, distinguish it from non-power records returned by the broad DIMM filter, provide units/scaling/semantics and expected load-dependent limits, and confirm whether Criteria 1, 2, 56 is only misnumbered or Criteria 3–55 are missing.

review_improvement: Separates CPU/DIMM power from unrelated DIMM telemetry, requires complete per-member topology and surface parity, and rejects the synthetic aggregate target and truncated evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: The string DIMM describes a hardware association, not a sensor type, so the source filter can return temperature, voltage, presence or power records. Power acceptance also depends on rail aggregation, memory population, workload and timing. Therefore neither all grep matches nor one invented aggregate reading can establish the intended coverage without an owner-approved population and map.
